index.html.title: Library Multimedia Studio
index.html.body: Launched on 19th January 2026 on the 3rd Floor of the Main Library. Equipped with professional broadcast microphones, acoustic wood paneling, bi-directional recording zones, and 4K video recording equipment. Designed to support faculty open courseware, student podcasting, academic dissertations, and digital scholarship.

services.html.title: Makerspace & Creative Innovation Lab
services.html.body: A dynamic collaborative space on the 1st Floor fostering design thinking, hardware prototyping, and interdisciplinary problem solving. Features collaborative circular seating, interactive smart boards, and presentation facilities.
